page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above the text: printed page number 126 and an ornamental band. Title block at head, then a verse poem in six stanzas set in italic, with a decorated initial S. Catchword "Crescet" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: RESPONSIO IOAN. IACOMOTI AD superius carmen.

l.i: Sic te repertor Phœbus amet lyra, Phœbique semper sic faueant tibi Nouum[?] sorores, Gratiaeq; Tergeminis tua rite circum
Sparsa nitescant scripta leporibus, Mellite vates: tempora cui ferunt Laurus obumbrantes decorem Teutonicas varium per urbes:
Ornare tantis laudibus abstine Laboriosa quae lyra pollice Tractata dicit: siue Reges Seu memorem violenta bella.
Non, si benignus Pieridum fauor Adire fontes Castalios sinit, Rupesque Parnassi bicornis Aerias timidum videre,
Vatum canoris me tamen inserit Choris, decentes Delphica queis comas Diffusa circum surgit arbos Perpetuum uiridante fronde.

page.notes: The initial S is a woodcut ornament and is joined to "ic" as "Sic". Line 1 "Nou-m" in the print is unclear; read as "Nouum" with [?]. The faint text in the background is show-through from the reverse page and is left out. Ornamental band at head is not text.
